Name: Seasongentle Hybrid Crops
Author: seasongentle
Description:
[b]What is this mod: [/b]This mod uses Spacechase Hybrid Crop Engine. Players can grow their own hybrid seasonal crops. 

[b]Installation:[/b] Extract the files into your mod folder.

[b]How it works:[/b]﻿ When 2[b] fully grown[/b] crops are next to each other, there's a 50% chance that a hybrid crop will sprout the next day in the nearby tilled soil (see screenshots for more detail).

[b]Recommended Mods[/b]: 
* You'll need the "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6577?tab=description]Hybrid Crop Engine[/url]" 
* [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1598][PPJA] Fruits and Veggies[/url]
